english.title: Refuse / neglect to answer a question / furnish information / produce document required under s.14
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), refused or neglected to

(A)_[answer a question,]_
(B)_[furnish information,]_
(C)_[produce a document,]_
(D)_[**(..COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE - SPECIFY..),]_

namely **(..SPECIFY QUESTION / INFORMATION / DOCUMENT..), when required to do so under section 14(1) of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998
english.legislation: Contrary to section 31(5)(b) and (9) of the National Minimum Wage Act 1998.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine

Time Limit for Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
